name: CA mortar
definition_zh: 文中用于板式轨道层间连接或填充的水泥乳化沥青砂浆。
usage_overview: CA砂浆在板式轨道中承担轨道板下的填充、支承和层间连接作用。动力模型常以连续分布的弹簧和阻尼器表示其作用；离缝损伤分析则关注其局部支承作用的丧失。

complete_examples.text: The track parameters, such as the stiffness of the rail pads, equivalent damping of CA mortar, and so on, are longitudinally varied along the railway lines.
Track slabs are connected to the subgrade using CA mortar, which is considered a continuous plane spring and dashpot.

The track sub-model consists of rails, rail pads, track slabs, CA mortar and subgrade bearing layers, in which the finite elements of beam and thin plate are applied to describe the dynamic characteristics of rails and track slabs, respectively, the subgrade layer is set to be a constraint element.

The stress state of integral track slab under two different constitutive models was compared and analyzed, and its dynamic damage law under the separation state between track slab and CA mortar layer was studied.
The advantages of 1D-CNN applied to CA mortar void recognition were discussed by comparing the performance of the other 3 neural networks.
From a deep learning perspective, the CA mortar void in the middle of the slab is less damaging and should focus on maintaining the CA mortar void at the slab end.
